title: It Could Happen Here Weekly 253
description:
All of this week's episodes of It Could Happen Here put together in one large file:

  • The Decline and Fall of the International Workers Movement
  • How To Print Your Own Money: The Case for Local Currencies
  • How the ‘Delivery Protection Act’ Takes on Amazon 
  • Attacking Palestinian Health
  • Executive Disorder: French Student Protests, Flavio Bolsonaro, ‘Third Country’ Deportations

You can now listen to all Cool Zone Media shows, 100% ad-free through the Cooler Zone Media subscription, available exclusively on Apple Podcasts. So, open your Apple Podcasts app, search for “Cooler Zone Media” and subscribe today!
